name: facebookresearch_mvdust3r/croco/stereoflow/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_mvdust3r/croco/stereofl.create_stereo_augmentor: create a StereoAugmentor instance with crop_size and augmentation probability parameters for stereo image pairs
facebookresearch_mvdust3r/croco/stereofl.apply_stereo_augmentation: apply random scale, crop, vertical flip, rotation, and color augmentations to stereo image pairs with disparity
facebookresearch_mvdust3r/croco/stereofl.create_flow_augmentor: create a FlowAugmentor instance with crop_size and spatial augmentation parameters for optical flow data
facebookresearch_mvdust3r/croco/stereofl.apply_flow_augmentation: apply random scale, stretch, flip, and color augmentations to image pairs with optical flow fields
facebookresearch_mvdust3r/croco/stereofl.resize_flow_sparse: resize sparse optical flow fields handling invalid values and coordinate remapping with scale factors

facebookresearch_mvdust3r/croco/stereofl.create_L1Loss: create an L1Loss instance to compute mean absolute error between predictions and ground truth with optional max_gtnorm filtering
facebookresearch_mvdust3r/croco/stereofl.create_LaplacianLoss: create a LaplacianLoss instance to compute confidence-weighted L1 loss using exponential confidence parametrization for stereo estimation
facebookresearch_mvdust3r/croco/stereofl.create_LaplacianLossBounded: create a LaplacianLossBounded instance to compute confidence-weighted loss with sigmoid-bounded confidence for optical flow estimation
facebookresearch_mvdust3r/croco/stereofl.compute_StereoMetrics: compute stereo batch metrics including avgerr, rmse, and bad pixel percentages at thresholds 0.5, 1, 2, and 3
facebookresearch_mvdust3r/croco/stereofl.aggregate_FlowDatasetMetrics: aggregate optical flow dataset metrics across batches tracking L1 error, EPE, bad pixels, and speed-binned EPE then retrieve results

facebookresearch_mvdust3r/croco/stereofl.create_FlowDataset: create a FlowDataset instance with a specified split and optional augmentation for optical flow training
facebookresearch_mvdust3r/croco/stereofl.build_get_train_dataset_flow: build a training dataset from a string specification like TartanAirDataset(train) with augmentation enabled
facebookresearch_mvdust3r/croco/stereofl.build_get_test_datasets_flow: build a list of test datasets from a string specification like Kitti15Dataset(test)+Kitti12Dataset(test)
facebookresearch_mvdust3r/croco/stereofl.run_flowToColor: run flowToColor on a numpy flow array to generate a color-coded visualization image
facebookresearch_mvdust3r/croco/stereofl.readFlowFile_writeFlowFile: read a .flo optical flow file into a numpy array or write flow predictions to a .flo file

facebookresearch_mvdust3r/croco/stereofl.create_stereo_dataset: create a StereoDataset subclass to load left-right image pairs and disparity maps for stereo depth estimation training
facebookresearch_mvdust3r/croco/stereofl.build_sceneflow_dataset: build a SceneFlowDataset to load driving, monkaa, and flyingthings stereo pairs with finalpass or cleanpass splits
facebookresearch_mvdust3r/croco/stereofl.run_train_dataset_stereo: run get_train_dataset_stereo with a dataset string like SceneFlowDataset(train_allpass) to get an augmented training dataset
facebookresearch_mvdust3r/croco/stereofl.test_stereo_datasets: test get_test_datasets_stereo with a plus-separated string like Kitti15Dataset(test)+MiddleburyEval3Dataset(test_full) to get evaluation datasets
facebookresearch_mvdust3r/croco/stereofl.visualize_disparity_map: visualize a disparity numpy array with vis_disparity using min/max normalization and an inferno colormap
